beauty/figS7.png: The same pair of panels for the estimation with beauty penalties excluded, and the same reason.
maive/fig2.png: Eight labelled panels (a)-(h) of bias against the correlation between the two regressors, one per estimator family. Checked against page 6 of the published article. It scores 2.8 flips per hundred rows -- the same ambiguous band as beauty's diagnostics -- and audit_figures --delete removed it on that basis in ea5e30d, which left the page pointing at a file that was not there.
